e: Single word at 20 months c̅ otherwise normal motor/social milestones = isolated expressive language delay → refer for speech & hearing evaluation.
Listeria monocytogenes is a classic late-neonatal (beyond first week) meningitis pathogen.
Prolonged jaundice + umbilical hernia → congenital hypothyroidism.
PDA c̅ reversed (R→L)/Eisenmenger shunt sends deoxygenated blood to the lower body → differential cyanosis.
Regression at 6-18 months, ↓es head growth & stereotypic hand-wringing = Rett syndrome.
Café-au-lait macules are the earliest, most characteristic cutaneous sign of NF1.
Kawasaki disease → bilateral non-exudative/non-purulent conjunctival injection, NOT purulent discharge.
Asymptomatic neonatal hypoglycemia c̅ good feeding → continue breastfeeding & monitor rather than IV dextrose.
Transplacental anti-Ro/anti-La → neonatal lupus erythematosus c̅ congenital complete heart block.
